description: Ouvrages et bassins de rétention is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Cet ensemble présente la géolocalisation ainsi que les informations générales des bassins de rétentions sur le territoire montréalais dont la construction est terminée. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Eau, Eau pluviale, Eau usée, SE. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2025-02-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
